hypothesis: For N<=16, independent width-N subgroups pack multiple rows per warp, preserving the original FP32 stage order. Static lane use motivates the candidate; no hardware-counter claim.
decision: Retain all negative results; compare with both original128 and the better same-run original128/256. Only stable >=5% gains in three screen and three holdout processes can support a dispatch proposal; unchanged-production controls and full production regression still required before adoption.
limitations: New timing protocol and hardware records; previous datasets are not relabelled. A800 results do not substitute for A100 acceptance.
